1.title: Democrats’ Top Senate Candidate in Maine Won’t Support Schumer for Leader
1.summary: Troy Jackson, who is set to become the party’s nominee, also said in an interview that he was not sure he wanted the support of Senator Chuck Schumer in the general election.

2.title: Pentagon Identifies Soldier Killed in Iran War as Sgt. Michael Emmanuel Swinton
2.summary: Sgt. Michael Emmanuel Swinton, the 17th service member to be named, was killed during the disposal of a drone in northern Iraq.

3.title: How Trump’s Immigration Crackdown Is Hurting Elder Care
3.summary: Retirement communities already grappling with labor shortages are being forced to terminate caregivers at a time when more Americans are living longer.

4.title: Israeli air strike in Gaza City kills family of six, medics say
4.summary: Firas al-Masri, his wife and their four children died in the attack, which the Israeli military says targeted a Hamas operative.

5.title: The Teenage Boys In Search of Their Mother After the Venezuela Earthquake
5.summary: After Venezuela’s devastating earthquakes, Winder and Deivi Delfín dug every day for 26 days to find the bodies of their mother, brother and grandmother.

6.title: A Family’s Daring Escape From North Korea
6.summary: Their resolve for freedom hardened during the pandemic, when they lived through a crippling food shortage and were forced to witness frequent public executions.
